comment: Zerg units of a player with an Arbiter (as a Dark Archon's Mind Control gives them): the Arbiter's field cloaks a Drone and a Mutalisk. The Drone starts a Hatchery under the field (ChangeUnitType 0x424ad0 clears the cloak bits of a unit that becomes a building, 0x41d4c0) and the Mutalisk mutates into a Guardian (the Cocoon is cloaked; ReplaceUnitImages 0x423330 keeps the cloak drawing over the new images, 0x416030 and 0x415e50).
